items.title: Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka have no respect for law, can breach peace and tranquility: Delhi SEM court

SEM Ritu Raj said that their assurance that they would not repeat the alleged conduct did not inspire confidence in light of their previous actions. The Court said that they showed "habitualness" by calling for protest at de-notified areas. Therefore, the Court extended their judicial custody by two days.
